set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java var raw = attributes.requestPath as String var m = raw scan /^\/k\/([^\/]+)(\/.*)?$/ var pathKey = if (isEmpty(m)) '' else m[0][1] var p0 = if (isEmpty(m)) raw else (m[0][2] default '/') var path = p0 replace /^\/\/+/ with '/' var h = attributes.headers var auth = h.authorization default '' var bearer = if ((auth startsWith 'Bearer ') and (sizeOf(auth) > 7)) auth[7 to -1] else '' var given = if (bearer != '') bearer else if ((h.'api-key' default '') != '') h.'api-key' else if (pathKey != '') pathKey else (attributes.queryParams.'api-key' default '') var key = p('api.key') default '' var serve = p('stat.serve') --- {path: path, method: attributes.method, ok: (key != '') and (given == key), serve: serve, kind: if (path startsWith '/api/') 'ollama' else if (path startsWith '/openai/') 'azure' else 'openai', embed: serve != 'llm', llm: serve != 'embed', deployment: ((path scan /^\/openai\/deployments\/([^\/]+)\/embeddings$/)[0][1]) default null}]
